turns.question: What was our real revenue in the first ten days of October 2026?
turns.answer: Revenue (EUR), the one definition of revenue (the sum of amount for non-cancelled orders), was 2,137.34 EUR for 1 to 10 October 2026 (net revenue, revenue minus partner returns, is a separate metric if that is what you meant by real). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
